استبحت (form X)

# اِسْتَبَحْتَ (istabaḥta) /is.ta.baħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
# اِسْتَبَحْتِ (istabaḥti) /is.ta.baħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
# اُسْتُبِحْتُ (ustubiḥtu) /us.tu.biħ.tu/: first-perso
